title: Expose active pull request link in main progress UI during implementation
specification:
# PRD: Expose active pull request link in main progress UI during implementation

Priority: medium

## Problem
When a PRD is in implementation or review, the main progress section shows status and task progress but does not give a direct pull request link. Managers have to find the separate pull request list instead of using the progress area they are already looking at.

## Goal
Make the main progress area show a clear clickable pull request action/link whenever the active PRD has an associated implementation or review pull request.

## Requirements
- Use existing `pullRequestStatuses` data for the active PRD and prefer the current active/review PR when multiple PRs exist.
- Show the link only when the active PRD is in implementation or review-related states and a valid PR URL exists.
- Place the link in the main progress area near the progress detail/button area so it is visible without scrolling to the PR section.
- Use clear button/link copy that includes PR context, such as the PR number or 'Open pull request'.
- Do not show the control if there is no matching PR URL for the active PRD.
- Keep existing progress stats and step rendering intact.

## Acceptance Criteria
- With an active PRD and matching `pullRequestStatuses[].url`, the progress section renders a visible clickable PR link/button.
- Clicking the control opens the correct GitHub pull request URL.
- When no active PR exists for the active PRD, the progress section renders no PR link/button.
- If multiple PR statuses exist for the active PRD, the UI consistently selects the most relevant active implementation/review PR.
- Existing PR list rendering and progress calculations continue to work unchanged.

## Verification
- Add or update unit coverage for active-PR selection logic for the progress section.
- Add UI rendering coverage for showing and hiding the link based on PRD state and PR URL presence.
- Manually verify in the control plane that an active implementation/review PR shows a link in the main progress area and opens the expected GitHub PR.

tasks.title: Show the active pull request link in the main progress area
tasks.description: Update the control-plane progress UI so the active PRD shows a visible pull request action in the main progress area during implementation and review states. Reuse existing `pullRequestStatuses` data, add or refine a helper that selects the most relevant active implementation or review pull request for the active PRD, and keep existing progress stats, step rendering, and separate pull request list behavior unchanged. Likely touch the project/control-plane progress UI and any status-selection utilities or view models that already derive active PRD and pull request state.
acceptance: When the active PRD is in an implementation or review-related state and `pullRequestStatuses` contains a matching valid URL, the main progress area renders a visible clickable pull request control near the existing progress detail or action area.
The rendered control opens the matching GitHub pull request URL and uses clear copy with pull request context, such as the PR number when available or equivalent open-pull-request wording.

When the active PRD has no matching pull request with a valid URL, or the active PRD is not in an implementation or review-related state, the main progress area does not render the pull request control.

If multiple pull request status records exist for the active PRD, the implementation uses deterministic selection logic that prefers the currently active implementation or review pull request over less relevant entries.
Existing progress metrics, step rendering, and the separate pull request list continue to render and behave as before.
Automated coverage is added or updated for active pull request selection logic and for progress-section rendering that shows and hides the link based on PRD state and URL presence.
Verification includes `npm run typecheck` and the relevant unit coverage for the control-plane progress UI or status-selection logic.
